params.caption: 🏆 PGL Cluj-Napoca invites revealed PGL has revealed the invited teams for its CS2 event in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. All 14 of the highest-ranked teams accepted their invitations, setting up a stacked field. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 13:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV #CS2 #Esports #GamingNews
